- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended websites and marketplaces for rare vinyl records: Discogs, eBay, MusicStack, Vinyl Collective, Reverb LP, Amazon Marketplace, Vinyl Me, Please, Facebook Groups, Local online classifieds, Specialty forums and websites.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for searching for rare vinyl records online: Research the seller's reputation, check the record's condition and authenticity, read reviews and descriptions carefully, ask questions, be prepared to negotiate prices, and watch for counterfeit records.
- [EVENT] User is looking for a rare pressing of Joy Division's "Closer."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Confirmed that the 1980 UK pressing on Factory Records of "Closer" is highly sought after and rare.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided details on rarity and value of the 1980 UK pressing of "Closer," stating it can fetch prices from £500 to £2,000 or more in mint condition.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Listed characteristics to identify the original pressing of "Closer": Label (Factory Records, FAC 25), Vinyl (black with matte finish), Cover (sleeve design by Peter Saville), Inner sleeve (plain white), Matrix numbers (FAC 25 A1/B1 or FAC 25 A2/B2).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested places to find the rare pressing: Discogs, eBay, specialist record stores, record fairs, online forums and communities, auction houses.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for purchasing rare records: Be prepared to pay a premium, research the seller, inspect the record, be cautious of reissues or bootlegs, and consider authentication.
